# Domain documentation

Before exploring a domain change, read [`CONTEXT.md`](../../CONTEXT.md) and the relevant accepted or proposed decisions in [`docs/adr/`](../../docs/adr/).

Use the glossary's terms in code, documentation, and review output. If a concept is missing or overloaded, resolve its canonical name before adding more documentation.

Keep `CONTEXT.md` as a glossary only. Put implementation details in a reference document and hard-to-reverse trade-offs in an ADR.

If a proposed change contradicts an accepted ADR, surface the conflict explicitly rather than silently overriding it.
